description: Pre-registered IV clinical observations for ECM generalization test. Supersedes commit 5f79d34 (v1, N=1 verified / N=2 blocked). Under v2 amendment (spec commit 6e7ce0a), bosentan and repaglinide formally dropped; glimepiride added as second verified substrate. DO NOT MODIFY after engine run — see spec docs/_internal/specs/2026-04-21-ecm-generalization-test-design.md §Freeze Contract.
primary_source_search_log: 2026-04-21. Original v1 search: Attempted PMC, EuropePMC REST API, DOI direct, Google Scholar, Semantic Scholar, ResearchGate, FABAD bioavailability PDF, EMA EPAR, FDA clinical pharmacology reviews, PBPK modeling papers, review articles (Dingemanse 2004 Clin Pharmacokinet, Kalliokoski 2009 BJP, Niemi 2011 Pharmacol Rev). Flesch 1997 full text obtained via Greek university repository (http://jupiter.chem.uoa.gr). Weber 1996 and Hatorp 1998 are subscription-only with no open-access version found after exhaustive search. v2 amendment survey (2026-04-21): PMC searched for glimepiride IV pharmacokinetics. Huang 2018 (OATP1B1 PBPK review, DOI 10.1007/s40262-018-0695-5) cites glimepiride as OATP1B1 substrate but does not tabulate IV Cmax. Badian M et al. 1994 Drug Metab Drug Interact 13:69-85 (PMID 8902432) identified as primary IV PK paper. Primary paper is paywalled; IV Cmax value 243 ng/mL obtained from open-access systematic review PMC11768776 Table 3 (which cites Badian 1994 as reference 63). Review-with-table path accepted per spec §Verification requirement.

dropped_under_amendment_v2.reason: Both drugs BLOCKED under v1 spec (primary IV Cmax sources paywalled; no open-access review tabulates the value; back-calculation forbidden per spec §Literature Data Extraction Protocol). Spec amendment v2 (commit 6e7ce0a) formally drops these drugs from the substrate set rather than carrying them as BLOCKED entries. Their full search logs are preserved in the git history of commit 5f79d34.

valsartan.infusion_duration_note: IV bolus injection, volume 10 mL delivered in approximately 30 seconds (Flesch 1997, Materials and Methods, Study 1 and Study 2).
valsartan.source: Flesch G, Müller P, Lloyd P. Absolute bioavailability and pharmacokinetics of valsartan, an angiotensin II receptor antagonist, in man. Eur J Clin Pharmacol 1997;52:115-120. PMID 9174680; DOI 10.1007/s002280050259. Table 1 (page 117): individual and mean pharmacokinetic parameters after 20 mg valsartan IV bolus in 12 healthy male volunteers. Mean Cmax = 4.02 mg/L (SD 0.43). Full text PDF obtained from http://jupiter.chem.uoa.gr/thanost/papers/papers8/EurJClinPharmacol_52(1997)115.pdf
valsartan.notes: Primary source verified. Table 1 reports individual Cmax for each of 12 subjects. Mean 4.02, SD 0.43, CV=10.7% (calculated from SD/mean). This is a direct table read from the full-text PDF of the primary paper. Administration was iv bolus (10 mL volume injected in ~30 s, see Methods). The pilot study (Study 1, n=3 per dose level) gave AUC dose-proportional from 5-10 mg with a tendency to disproportionate increase at 20 mg; the main study (Study 2) used 20 mg IV bolus + 80 mg oral capsule or solution in 12 subjects crossover. The observed CV (10.7%) is lower than the spec's default 0.35; using the observed CV which reflects actual inter-subject variability.

glimepiride.source: Badian M et al. 1994 Drug Metab Drug Interact 13:69-85 (PMID 8902432). 1 mg IV single dose in healthy volunteers (N=12). Cmax = 243 ± 33 ng/mL (= 0.243 ± 0.033 mg/L). Primary paper paywalled; Cmax value cited in open-access systematic review PMC11768776 Table 3 (citing reference 63 = Badian 1994).
glimepiride.notes: IV Cmax accessible via systematic review (PMC11768776); primary paper paywalled. Values used are the systematic review's tabulation of Badian 1994 data. Individual subject values not available from review. CV computed from SD/mean = 33/243 = 0.136. SMILES is the RDKit canonical form of PubChem CID 3476 (C24H34N4O5S, MW 490.63). The SMILES provided in the spec task was incorrect (C24H35N5O4S, a different compound); corrected to PubChem canonical during Task 1 execution.

outcome_note: 2/2 drugs verified under v2 amendment substrate set. Valsartan: primary source verified from full-text PDF (Flesch 1997 Table 1). Glimepiride: IV Cmax verified via review-with-table path (PMC11768776 Table 3 citing Badian 1994), accepted per spec §Verification requirement when primary paper is paywalled and review tabulates the value. N_effective=2. Both drugs ready for engine run.
